{{Top|leg}}
A '''Memorial Capsule''' was purchased every time an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] made the decision to [[Return (Alderaanian)|return]] and pay their respects to their loved ones. In it items intended for the [[Death/Legends|deceased]] were placed and then jettisoned to orbit amid [[the Graveyard]].<ref name="BW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
